description: Compare one strand year over year, for pacing, remediation, and differentiation. Pass a `code` (e.g. '5.NR.1') to line that standard up against the same code at every grade ('3.NR.1', '4.NR.1', ...), or pass `subject` + `strand_code` (name or code) for the whole strand. Returns `grades`, each with `grade`, `grade_label`, and `standards` (code, statement, and gmas/ald flags). The trace matches codes by shape; `state_links` lists the steps (`from`, `to`) that Georgia's own data also links grade to grade (ELA only). If the strand can't be identified, the result is an error.

code.description: A standard code to trace, e.g. '5.NR.1'.
code.title: Code

strand_code.description: Strand code ('NR') or name ('Numerical Reasoning'). Use with subject.
strand_code.title: Strand Code
